# MatchMind

> AI football intelligence for World Cup 2026 fans. MatchMind classifies fan questions, queries a MongoDB Atlas football database via MCP tools, and returns analyst-grade insights — powered by Gemini and Google Cloud Agent Builder.

MatchMind is a Next.js web app with a fan-facing agent and an optional admin agent for curated data updates. It is not a live FIFA broadcast feed.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://matchmind.xyz/): Product overview, features, and FAQ
- [Football Intelligence Agent](https://matchmind.xyz/agent): Ask World Cup 2026 stats, predictions, fantasy, tactics, and history
- [Architecture](https://matchmind.xyz/docs/architecture): Technical overview of the agent pipeline and stack
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/mojeebdev/matchmind): Source code, setup, and README
- [Architecture (Markdown)](https://github.com/mojeebdev/matchmind/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Full architecture document

## What We Do Not Do

MatchMind does not provide:
- Live FIFA broadcast scores or official real-time match feeds
- Betting advice or gambling recommendations
- Guaranteed match outcome predictions
